subject: Coordination: incident readiness artifacts, retention window, and postmortem summary
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@fintegrity.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@ingestify.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: IR test artifacts + retention clarification

Hi Lauren,

Following up from our vendor security review: can you share the artifacts from the tabletop exercise you ran in October and confirm Redwood's runtime telemetry retention window for incident triage (auth logs, request traces, and audit logs)? Our SOC 2 scope needs the retention answers and a pointer to the evidence package we can ingest into our SIG/CAIQ workbook.

Specific asks:
- A sanitized postmortem or summary of the Oct 28 drill (high level) we can reference in procurement
- A manifest of artifacts (logs, runbooks, capture scripts) and their formats
- Confirmation of retention windows and whether exports are available on request (S3 or secure share)

We have a procurement deadline next Tuesday, so if you can confirm timelines that would be great.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Senior Security Program Manager, Fintegrity
[Attachment: ingestion_requirements.pdf (PDF, 230KB)]

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@fintegrity.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: IR test artifacts + retention clarification

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide a sanitized postmortem summary and a manifest within 48 hours.
- Runtime telemetry retention: default production retention is 90 days for request traces and auth logs; audit logs retained for 365 days. Exports are available on request (S3 export with customer-managed keys or secure Drive link).

Plan:
1) I'll attach a redacted summary of the Oct 28 drill and the artifact manifest by end of day tomorrow.
2) Marissa (forensics/IR) will produce the log export ETA and deliver the manifest CSV with exact file names and checksums.
3) Markus will confirm any SOC 2 control crosswalk entries for the SIG/CAIQ fields you flagged.

If you need an earlier-hand preview for procurement, we can provide a sanitized summary now and the full manifest as soon as the exports are staged.

Next steps: can you confirm what file transfer method you prefer (S3 with pre-signed links, secure Drive, or your vendor portal)?

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 980KB)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@fintegrity.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: IR test artifacts + retention clarification

Elaine / Lauren — looping in the artifact owner.

Status update:
- I've staged the log exports and generated an evidence manifest (attached). Files include: sanitized-syslogs-20271028.ndjson (redacted), kvcache-snapshot-20271028.tar.gz (sanitized), and timeline-trace-20271028.jsonl.
- Manifest includes SHA256 checksums and schema types for the SIG workbook.
- ETA to make exports available as pre-signed S3 links: 24 hours after sign-off. If you prefer Drive, we can mirror within 6 hours of S3 staging.

Note on postmortem: the full internal postmortem contains vendor-identifying details and is embargoed for 72 hours after internal review. We can provide the sanitized 1-page executive summary now (attached) and the redact-ready full artifact bundle after embargo.

Attachments: ir_evidence_manifest_20271103.csv; sanitized_postmortem_execsum.txt

Marissa Cole
Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ir_evidence_manifest_20271103.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Elaine Park <elaine@fintegrity.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: IR test artifacts + retention clarification

Lauren — thanks, that works. We prefer S3 pre-signed links with customer-managed KMS if possible; our procurement team requires that for ingest. Two quick follow-ups:
- Can you confirm whether audit-log exports include the raw auth headers (we typically ask for masked headers but need schema confirmation)?
- For the sanitized summary: will it include a timeline (minute-level) and remediation status fields we can map into our CAIQ cells?

Procurement also asked whether the sanitized summary can be signed off by a senior security leader for the record. If that's possible, please let us know who would sign.

Best,
Elaine

On Thu, Nov 4, 2027 at 09:18, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Elaine / Lauren — looping in the artifact owner.
> 
> Status update:...

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@fintegrity.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: IR test artifacts + retention clarification

Elaine — finalizing deliverables below.

Deliverables provided:
- redwood_sanitized_postmortem_20271028.pdf (attached) — 1-page executive summary, includes minute-level timeline (redacted), remediation status, and controls impacted. Signed by Markus Klein (VP, Security).
- ir_evidence_manifest_20271103.csv (attached) — file list, formats, checksums, and suggested CAIQ/SIG mapping columns included.
- Pre-signed S3 links prepared for all files; they use customer-managed KMS and will expire in 7 days. Link group: https://s3.redwood-secure.example/ingestify/ingestify-ir-20271103 (pre-signed bundle).

Notes:
- Audit logs exclude raw auth header values by default; schema column "auth_header_masked" is present in the manifest. If you require a different mask pattern, we can discuss on a quick call.
- Full internal postmortem (containing vendor-identifying details) will be released under NDA and after the 72-hour internal review window; we can coordinate an NDA if you need that bundle for deeper due diligence.

If everything looks good, I'll ask Legal to trigger a short one-page confidentiality amendment and we'll open the S3 access.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the mapping to CAIQ.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_sanitized_postmortem_20271028.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]
